main_text.l: Celsissimo & Illustrissimo Principi, Dn. Dn. FREDERICO GVILIELMO,
Illa armis opibusque potens, atque ubere gleba
Unam quam Rhenus pleno Pater irrigat alveo,
Non alibi placidus non tumidusve magis.
Hoc tantum infelix Regio, primordia gentis,
suæ. Quodq; diu trepidet turbantibus undiq; bellis,
Dum Mars vicino fervidus orbe furit.
Te Duce nunc alius rerum promittitur ordo,
Et novus Historiæ te Duce surgit honos.
Quæ prælustre tuum jam præfert pagina nomen,
Non dubias infert in loca cæca faces,
Non vetus hic canitur vulgati fabula cygni,

page.notes: The initial M is a large woodcut letter. Ornamented initial and italic headings reproduced as best read. Passage lines in the verse are set as printed; a few letters in the verse are uncertain (e.g. "prælustre", "Quæ") and may be misread. The "(?)(?)" marks at the foot are doubtful.
